title: Baap Ko Rote Rote
body:
baap ko rote rote sakina
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha logon ne abid se aa kar
hai ye zindan may shor kaisa
hum pe tooti hai phir ek qayamat
ro ke abid ne bas ye bataya
wo jo raaton ko karti thi nauha
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
zabt karti rahi apna girya
shimr ke darr se royi nahi thi
jab se choota hai baba ka seena
ek lamha bhi soyi nahi thi
baap ke moo pe moo rakh ke dukhiya
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar shaheedon ke jis waqt aaye
qaid khane may tha shor e matam
baap ke sar ko seene laga kar
aise royi labon par ruka dam
maa ye samjhi ke jaagi hazeena
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon bhara ek kurta kafan hai
ghusl ashkon se hi isko doonga
log apne na apna watan hai
is ghareebi may bhai kare kya
bekafan baap ki ye yateema
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
qabr may kaise isko utaarun
dast o paa mere zanjeer may hai
sab ko samjha gayi meri behna
aur bhi zakhm taqdeer may hai
jee raha hoo mai aur meri behna
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhte likhte tadapta hai mazhar
bain bano ke aise thay safdar
shaam ki aurton se ye boli
ek diya tum jala dena aa kar
is andhere may ro ro ke dukhiya
aaj zindan may so gayi hai
baap ko rote rote...
author: Mazhar Abidi
